narrower_hypothesis.name: Zero-migration Agent PR Recovery Digest
narrower_hypothesis.job_to_be_done: For an existing repository already using heterogeneous coding agents, identify from read-only repository and optional receipt evidence why an agent-created PR is stalled, whether it is safely recoverable, what evidence is missing, and the next smallest safe action without requiring the team to adopt a new orchestration control plane first.
boundary: no migration into a proprietary workflow
explicit UNKNOWN when evidence is insufficient
exact evidence links for each classification
narrower_hypothesis.claimed_gap_to_falsify: Existing substitutes are strong at running, monitoring or governing agents, but a zero-migration forensic recovery layer for already-existing heterogeneous PR workflows may reduce adoption friction. This is not yet proven.
kill_criteria: a current substitute already diagnoses stalled heterogeneous PR workflows with equivalent read-only zero-migration evidence and negligible setup
repository-native evidence is insufficient to classify recovery safely without invasive integrations
target teams do not experience recurring stalled-agent PR or approval-fragmentation pain
the output is only a repackaging of native GitHub or GitLab views
external users show no willingness to try the workflow
narrower_hypothesis.smallest_next_experiment: Build a fixture-bound read-only classifier only after the exact classification contract is frozen; compare its output against native repository views and at least one substitute. Do not build a dashboard or hosted service.
